# capsulectl's deal view manifest

`deal-view.manifest.json` is capsule-cli's `internal/cli/assets/deal-view.manifest.json`
(`capsulectl.deal-view/v0`, the deal page as a registered presentation module),
copied unmodified from capsule-cli main @ `e4bbadda89aa7b4ab8b41e57e7347977be61d857`
(sha256 `605bc2e5aa7b68da6e988fac9ba5c1a726b5f4c5460308c1e717a8d3de05d628`).
`tests/test_history_module.py` checks the History Card manifest against it with
the registry's static ambiguity test. It is a test vector only; capsule-cli is
the source.
